_comment: v0.11.0 blog shots, first pass against the demo (:8091). Slugs match image refs in src/content/blog/v0-11-0.md. Login marks every What's new release seen so the pop-up never covers a shot. whats-new-popup opens the pop-up by dispatching the resolvd:whats-new event for release 2 (in the demo DB the reseed put every change file in one release; it was split so release 1 = v0.10.0 and release 2 = the six v0.11.0 files), so it works even though login marks releases seen. masquerade-banner must stay LAST: it switches the session to a Submitter. apply-form uses ACME-0007 (ticket id 23, emailed in without a form); kb-pdf-link uses ACME-0009 (id 25), whose reply links pages 2 and 3 of the Acme Co. restart guide PDF.

steps.eval: fetch('/api/whats-new/unseen').then(r => r.json()).then(d => Promise.all((d.releases || []).map(x => fetch('/api/whats-new/seen', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ release_id: x.id }) }))))

actions.eval: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h3')].find(h => h.textContent.trim().startsWith('Rate cards')); if (h) { h.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); window.scrollBy(0, -96); } })()

(() => { const s = [...document.querySelectorAll('select')].find(el => [...el.options].some(o => o.text.trim() === "Any status")); if (!s) return; const o = [...s.options].find(o => o.text.trim() === "Any status"); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(s, o.value); s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); })()
(() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2')].find(h => h.textContent.trim().startsWith('Business hours')); if (h) { h.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start' }); window.scrollBy(0, -96); } })()

fetch('/api/impersonate/3', { method: 'POST' }).then(() => fetch('/api/whats-new/unseen').then(r => r.json()).then(d => Promise.all((d.releases || []).map(x => fetch('/api/whats-new/seen', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ release_id: x.id }) }))))).then(() => { location.href = '/dashboard'; })
